vocabulary.meaning_en: the main meal in the evening

vocabulary.meaning_en: making a lot of noise
vocabulary.example: The music next door is too loud.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to clean with water
vocabulary.example: I wash my clothes on Fridays.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a big room at university for lessons

vocabulary.meaning_en: the last time or day to finish something
vocabulary.example: The deadline is next Monday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a piece of work given to a student
vocabulary.example: I finished my history assignment.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an idea
vocabulary.example: This concept is hard to understand.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put your name on a list to join something
vocabulary.example: I signed up for an English course.

vocabulary.meaning_en: half of a school or university year
vocabulary.example: Next semester starts in September.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to change the time of a planned event
vocabulary.example: Can we reschedule the call to Thursday?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a written document with information
vocabulary.example: Please send me the report today.

vocabulary.meaning_en: programs used on a computer
vocabulary.example: The new software is easy to use.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a day when you don't work
vocabulary.example: I'm taking a day off on Sunday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how big something is
vocabulary.example: Do you have this in a smaller size?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have a price
vocabulary.example: How much does this bag cost?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a plastic card used to pay

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put on clothes to check the size
vocabulary.example: Can I try on these shoes?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a seat next to the window

vocabulary.meaning_en: the main central part of a city

vocabulary.meaning_en: to pay money to use something for a time

vocabulary.meaning_en: a building where you see old or important things

fine_lines.title: turn off vs turn down
fine_lines.explanation_ar: turn off تعني إطفاء الجهاز أو الضوء تمامًا. turn down تعني تخفيض الصوت أو الحرارة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Turn off" stops something completely. "Turn down" makes the sound or heat lower.

examples.sentence: Please turn off the lights when you leave.
The TV is too loud. Please turn it down.

fine_lines.title: Can you...? vs Could you...?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما لطلب شيء. Could you أكثر أدبًا ورسمية من Can you.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both make requests. "Could you" is more polite than "Can you".

examples.sentence: Can you help me with this?
Could you recommend a good hotel?

fine_lines.title: try vs try on
fine_lines.explanation_ar: try تعني يحاول أو يتذوق. try on تُستخدم للملابس: يلبسها ليرى المقاس.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Try" means attempt or taste. "Try on" is for clothes: wear them to check.

examples.sentence: I'd like to try this T-shirt on.

expressions.phrase: What's for dinner tonight?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking what we will eat this evening.
expressions.example: Mom, what's for dinner tonight?

expressions.phrase: It's time to clean the house.
expressions.meaning_en: We must start cleaning now.
expressions.example: Okay everyone, it's time to clean the house.

expressions.phrase: Could you turn off the lights, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك إطفاء الأنوار من فضلك؟
expressions.meaning_en: A polite request to switch off the lights.
expressions.example: I want to sleep. Could you turn off the lights, please?

expressions.phrase: The TV is too loud. Could you please turn it down?
expressions.meaning_ar: التلفاز صوته عالٍ جدًا، هل يمكنك تخفيضه من فضلك؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking someone to make the TV quieter.
expressions.example: The TV is too loud. Could you please turn it down? I'm studying.

expressions.phrase: I need to wash some clothes.
expressions.meaning_en: I have dirty clothes to clean.
expressions.example: I need to wash some clothes before the trip.

expressions.phrase: Where is the lecture hall?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking for the room of the class.
expressions.example: Excuse me, where is the lecture hall?

expressions.phrase: What is the deadline for this assignment?
expressions.meaning_en: When must I finish this work?
expressions.example: What is the deadline for this assignment? Friday?

expressions.phrase: Do you want to study together for the exam?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل تريد أن نذاكر معًا للامتحان؟
expressions.meaning_en: Inviting a classmate to study with you.
expressions.example: Do you want to study together for the exam tomorrow?

expressions.phrase: Can you help me understand this concept?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك مساعدتي على فهم هذا المفهوم؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking for an explanation.
expressions.example: Can you help me understand this concept? It's new to me.

expressions.phrase: I need to sign up for next semester's classes.
expressions.meaning_ar: أحتاج أن أسجل في مواد الفصل القادم.
expressions.meaning_en: I must register for next term.
expressions.example: I need to sign up for next semester's classes this week.

expressions.phrase: When is the deadline for this project?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking when the project must be finished.
expressions.example: When is the deadline for this project?

expressions.phrase: Can we reschedule the meeting?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking to change the time of a meeting.
expressions.example: I'm sick today. Can we reschedule the meeting?

expressions.phrase: I need help with this report.
expressions.meaning_en: Asking a colleague for help.
expressions.example: I need help with this report. Do you have time?

expressions.phrase: Can you show me how to use this software?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك أن تريني كيف أستخدم هذا البرنامج؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking someone to teach you a program.
expressions.example: I'm new here. Can you show me how to use this software?

expressions.phrase: I need to take a day off.
expressions.meaning_en: I must not come to work for one day.
expressions.example: I need to take a day off next Tuesday.

expressions.phrase: Where can I find fresh vegetables?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking in a shop where something is.
expressions.example: Excuse me, where can I find fresh vegetables?

expressions.phrase: Do you have this shirt in a larger size?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل لديكم هذا القميص بمقاس أكبر؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking for a bigger size.
expressions.example: This is too small. Do you have this shirt in a larger size?

expressions.phrase: How much does this cost?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking the price.
expressions.example: How much does this cost? - Twenty riyals.

expressions.phrase: Can I pay by credit card?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking about payment method.
expressions.example: Can I pay by credit card, or only cash?

expressions.phrase: I would like to try this T-shirt on.
expressions.meaning_en: I want to wear it to check the size.
expressions.example: I would like to try this T-shirt on. Where is the fitting room?

expressions.phrase: Can I have a window seat, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني الحصول على مقعد بجانب النافذة؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking for a seat by the window.
expressions.example: Can I have a window seat, please?

expressions.phrase: When is the next bus to the city center?
expressions.meaning_ar: متى الحافلة القادمة إلى وسط المدينة؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking about bus times.
expressions.example: When is the next bus to the city center?

expressions.phrase: Could you recommend a good hotel?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك أن تنصحني بفندق جيد؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking for advice about a hotel.
expressions.example: Could you recommend a good hotel near the airport?

expressions.phrase: I would like to rent a car.
expressions.meaning_en: I want to pay to use a car for some days.
expressions.example: I would like to rent a car for three days.

expressions.phrase: What's the best way to get to the museum?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما أفضل طريقة للوصول إلى المتحف؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking for directions or transport.
expressions.example: What's the best way to get to the museum? Bus or taxi?

grammar.title: I need to + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم I need to + الفعل الأصلي لنقول إن شيئًا ضروري علينا فعله. وI need + اسم لنقول إننا نحتاج شيئًا: I need help.
grammar.explanation_en: Use "I need to + base verb" for something you must do. Use "I need + noun" for something you want to have.
examples: I need to wash some clothes.
I need to take a day off.
I need help with this report.

grammar.title: Polite questions: Can I...? / Could you...?
grammar.explanation_ar: Can I + فعل نطلب به إذنًا أو شيئًا لأنفسنا. Could you + فعل نطلب به من شخص أن يفعل شيئًا بأدب أكثر. الفعل بعدهما في صيغته الأصلية.
grammar.explanation_en: "Can I + verb" asks for permission or something for you. "Could you + verb" asks someone politely to do something. Use the base verb after both.
examples: Can I pay by credit card?
Can I have a window seat, please?
Could you turn off the lights, please?

grammar.title: I would like to + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: I would like to (أو I'd like to) طريقة مهذبة لقول I want to عند الطلب في المحلات والفنادق.
grammar.explanation_en: "I would like to" (I'd like to) is a polite way to say "I want to" in shops and hotels.
examples: I would like to rent a car.
I would like to try this T-shirt on.
I'd like to book a room.

grammar.title: Wh- questions: Where / When / What / How much
grammar.explanation_ar: Where للمكان، When للزمان، What للشيء، How much للسعر. مع الفعل الأساسي نستخدم does: How much does this cost?
grammar.explanation_en: Where = place, When = time, What = thing, How much = price. With a normal verb add do/does: How much does this cost?

questions.question: The TV is too loud. You say: "Could you please turn it ___?"
What is a "deadline"?
choices: the last time to finish something
questions.explanation_en: A deadline is the last time to finish work.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال الصحيح: How much does this cost? مع does والفعل الأصلي.
questions.explanation_en: Use "does" + base verb: How much does this cost?

questions.question: You are in a clothes shop. You want to check if the shirt fits. You say:
choices: I would like to try this shirt on.
I would like to rent this shirt.
I need to wash this shirt.

questions.question: Which request is the most polite?
choices: Could you recommend a good hotel?

questions.question: "I need ___ a day off."
questions.explanation_ar: بعد I need نستخدم to + الفعل الأصلي.

questions.question: Where do students listen to lessons at university?
questions.explanation_en: A lecture hall is a big classroom at university.

questions.question: You want to know when the bus leaves. You ask:
choices: When is the next bus to the city center?
How much is the next bus?

questions.question: "I'm going to bed. Could you turn ___ the lights, please?"
questions.explanation_en: "Turn off" switches the lights off completely.
